title: Vitamin D and bone health
text: Vitamin D deficiency is associated with osteoporosis and fractures in older adults.

title: Statins and cholesterol
text: Statins lower LDL cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular events.

title: Fiber intake
text: Dietary fiber from whole grains lowers the risk of colorectal cancer.

title: Processed meat
text: Processed meat consumption is linked to colorectal cancer risk.

title: Sodium and blood pressure
text: High sodium intake raises blood pressure; reducing salt lowers hypertension risk.

title: Green tea
text: Green tea catechins have antioxidant effects in laboratory studies.

title: Calcium supplements
text: Calcium supplements may modestly increase bone mineral density.

title: Exercise
text: Regular aerobic exercise lowers resting blood pressure.
